candidate_evaluation.classifier: Normalized adapter-projected BGE class prompts; reconstructed missing initializer.
candidate_evaluation.inference: Original adapter class and predict() on re-extracted original DINOv2/BGE features; CPU fp32 eval.
candidate_evaluation.limits: One candidate checkpoint; not five-seed statistics and not proven historical Figure-12 reproduction.

new_coco_evaluation.aggregation: Arithmetic mean and sample SD across five trained adapters; CLIP fixed once
new_coco_evaluation.checkpoint_rule: All controlled full-COCO RP+ES checkpoints for seeds 0,1,3,7,42; none excluded
new_coco_evaluation.inference: CPU fp32; eval mode; no RP/mixing/dropout/finetuning; L2-normalized projected features; argmax cosine
new_coco_evaluation.limitations: Convenience subsets; not official medical benchmark splits or patient-level evaluation; no clinical efficacy claim
new_coco_evaluation.metrics: Image-level top1 accuracy and mean per-class recall (balanced accuracy)
new_coco_evaluation.prompts: One recovered This is a <class> caption per class; BGE uses original BLIP lowercase/punctuation cleanup; CLIP original tokenize
new_coco_evaluation.selection: All entries of recovered test lists; historical selection mechanism unknown

privacy: Public IDs are dataset-local indices. Image hashes/paths, medical images and private chats are not released.
publication_status: Supplementary arithmetic evidence; historical five-value reconstruction remains unestablished.
scope: Scores-to-metrics reproduction; raw images and model weights are required separately for pixel-level inference.
